brief:
Palestinians face a battle over historical memory as the October 7 anniversary approaches, according to Shehab Wire. Major political commemorations spark competing efforts to shape how events are remembered and interpreted. The narrative framework that prevails determines how responsibility and victimhood are assigned in public discourse.

The struggle over storytelling carries weight comparable to battlefield confrontations themselves. Events survive not merely through what occurred, but through accounts constructed afterward. Those who control the narrative's framing exercise significant power over how history records the actors and their roles.

title: Palestinians contest narrative of October 7 anniversary
